uk.s: Register for the campaign: Join Now
SOQ — guaranteed once you hit the tier. Distributed within 7 business days after the event ends.
New Users are users who register a BTSE account during the campaign period. Users who registered before the campaign starts are Existing Users.
Task 2: New Users have higher odds of winning the top prize than Existing Users. After the campaign ends, the system will automatically conduct the draw for eligible users based on their Net Deposit.
Task 2: Limited to the top 1,000 users with a Net Deposit of ≥ 100 USDT, ranked by Net Deposit from highest to lowest. Users with the same Net Deposit are ranked by the time they reached it.
Click “Join Now” on the campaign page to register. Only actions completed after successful registration will be counted toward campaign results.

Task 3: Only the highest tier reached will be credited. vipUSDT and USDT rewards within the same tier can both be received. Rewards are credited in the order targets are reached. If a tier’s slots are full, the reward will be credited at the next lower tier.
Rewards will be distributed within 14 business days after the campaign ends. The actual token received will be subject to the final distribution.
The campaign is unavailable in restricted jurisdictions, as defined in BTSE’s Terms of Use and platform announcements.
Click “Join now” to subscribe to a Locked product and start earning fixed returns.

Eligible participants must have verified their identity, with their accounts in good standing. The campaign is unavailable in restricted jurisdictions, as defined in BTSE’s Terms of Use and platform announcements.
Rewards will be credited within 14 business days after the campaign ends. The actual currency received is subject to final crediting.
Rewards cannot be combined with other concurrent BTSE campaigns of the same type (including registration, deposit, or trading campaigns). Only the highest eligible reward will be credited.
Only users who register on or after November 11, 2026, 08:00 (UTC+0) are eligible for New User Exclusive products.

Rewards cannot be combined with other concurrent BTSE campaigns of the same type (including registration, deposit, or trading related campaigns). Rewards for a specific campaign cannot be claimed by a user more than once; only the highest eligible reward will be distributed.
New users can easily get 5 lucky draws
Head to the CandyBomb page and click the Join button.

Users with a VIP Trial Pass can register only after holding the pass for at least 2 days, provided their VIP status is still active. If the pass expires during the campaign, they will no longer be eligible to participate, and any unused lucky draw chances will be forfeited.

The campaign features a total prize pool of 500,000 USDT, comprising 300,000 USDT in lucky draw rewards and 200,000 USDT in futures trading rewards. Futures trading rewards will be distributed based on the specified trading volume milestones.
Eligibility: main accounts that have completed identity verification and take part in this IPO Prime round with USDT or USDGO (sub-accounts excluded).

Without prejudice to the foregoing, each of OKX Wallet and the Organiser also reserves the right to revoke the eligibility of any user or wallet address whom it reasonably suspects is engaging in dishonest or abusive conduct, including but not limited to circumstances where users enter multiple wallet addresses to obtain additional rewards, engage in wallet address churning to earn rewards, engage in money-laundering or wash trades, or engage in any other illegal, fraudulent or harmful activity. Users and/or wallet address(es) reasonably suspected of engaging in such conduct may be banned from participating in any future campaigns on OKX Wallet's website and/or platform.
Register for the event to start earning rewards.

Starting Dec 30, 2024, users in the EEA will no longer be able to register for events or receive rewards. The EEA includes the following countries: Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, the Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Romania, Portugal, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, and Sweden.
Rewards are distributed on a first-come, first-served basis.

Trading bonus rewards shall be distributed automatically within three (3) days of the completion of each task, whereas VIP trial rewards shall be issued based on the last task completed. Users who have not received their next-tier VIP trial reward after fulfilling the applicable requirements shall contact Customer Support for assistance.
The daily tasks are reset at 12:00 AM (UTC+8) each day. New user tasks will not be reset.
Affiliates and sub-accounts are not eligible for this campaign.
A successful referral requires a friend to register through your referral link and reach 200 USDT in cumulative trading volume within 14 days of registration.
Rewards will be credited to your Vouchers upon reaching each milestone.
After registration, join a squad before Nov 19, 10AM UTC. You must join separately with your Main Account and each Subaccount.
Register for the Campaign
